integrity: Analytical proof and 12430 exact finite checks provided. The finite checks do not replace the infinite proof or establish novelty.
scientific_limitations: Uniform transitions on looped complete bipartite graphs; both part sizes grow and their ratio stays bounded away from zero. First-order worst-case total-variation cutoff only; no width profile or loop-free periodic result.
title: Cutoff for last-exit unicycle walks on looped complete bipartite graphs
